guidelines: Never use generic sans (like Inter) for headings. Use Outfit.
Headings must use tracking-tight to feel premium and compressed.
Data labels must be uppercase, tiny, and wide-spaced.
Use deeply tinted black (#050505) instead of pure #000000 for backgrounds.
Use #BEF264 strictly for AI-generated insights (Score, Action, Reasoning) to make them pop.
Primary CTA buttons are stark white (#FAFAFA) with black text for Brutalist contrast.

surfaces: Dashboard panels: Solid background (#0E0E11), 1px solid border (#1F1F24), NO drop shadow.
AI Panels: Use a subtle inner glow or a 1px border of ai_highlight_muted for the 'AI Reasoning' card.
textures: Use minimalistic dark geometry image as a subtle background layer for the Login/Register screen to kill digital flatness.

shadcn_customizations.cards: Remove default shadows. Use flat #0E0E11 background with #1F1F24 borders. Border radius: rounded-lg.
shadcn_customizations.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Avoid default generic grey hovers; explicitly define text color on hover.
shadcn_customizations.tables: Dense structure. Use border-b on rows, no alternating row colors. Row hover: hover:bg-[#16161A].
shadcn_customizations.badges: Sharp rounded edges. Distinct background color with matching high-contrast text.

grids_layouts.dashboard_stats: Bento Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Use 'Technical Look' with border-collapse and shared 1px borders between stats.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside structural cards to prevent text collision. Use gap-4 or gap-6 for grids.
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align data arrays and forms. Only center the login form card.

guidelines: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Micro-animations on row hover: slightly change background color smoothly.
Toast notifications (sonner) should slide in gracefully.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-lead-btn').
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text.
Never rely on motion alone for feedback.
Set explicit hover states with text color (hover:bg-[#16161A] hover:text-[#EDEDED]).
Avoid completely transparent backgrounds for elements with content layered beneath.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark geometry for the login/register screen background to give a premium, moody feel.
Professional male avatar for the logged-in user profile.

libraries.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboards. (Install: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react)
libraries.charts: Use recharts for pipeline value and lead status distribution. (Install: yarn add recharts)
libraries.toasts: Use sonner for notifications. (Already in shadcn/ui)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Outfit and IBM Plex Sans fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
Setup routing for Login/Register, Dashboard, Leads List, and Lead Details views.
Build a Left Sidebar or Top Nav. Top Nav is preferred for CRM dashboards to maximize horizontal space for tables.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, tables, and selects. Customize their look to match the flat, border-heavy dark theme.
AI generated content (Score, Reasoning, Message) MUST be visually distinct. Use the ai_highlight color (#BEF264) for these elements (text or subtle backgrounds/borders).
Create a Lead list table with search, filter by stage/priority, and edit/delete actions.
Implement Lead stage management with a dropdown or Kanban board in the Leads view.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) strictly for headers/sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use the specified icon library (@phosphor-icons/react).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component is located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx` or `.js`.
